name: Baeocystin
summary: Baeocystin, also known as norpsilocybin or 4-phosphoryloxy-N-methyltryptamine (4-PO-NMT), is a zwitterionic alkaloid of the tryptamine family and an analogue of psilocybin (4-PO-DMT). It is found as a minor compound in most psilocybin mushrooms together with psilocybin, psilocin (4-HO-DMT), norbaeocystin (4-PO-T), and aeruginascin (4-PO-TMT).

pharmacology.text: Baeocystin is thought to be a prodrug of norpsilocin, analogously to how psilocybin is a prodrug of psilocin. Norpsilocin is a potent and centrally penetrant agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor and also interacts with other serotonin receptors.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.text: Chemist and mycologist Jochen Gartz reported in the 1990s that baeocystin is active as a psychedelic in humans.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it on its own in people. Psilocybin-type psychedelics can cause nausea, anxiety, confusion, a raised heart rate and frightening experiences, and can trigger psychosis in people who are prone to it.
sideEffects.zh: 它單獨在人體中的作用所知甚少。裸蓋菇素類迷幻藥可能造成噁心、焦慮、混亂、心跳加快與驚恐的經驗，並可能在易感者身上誘發精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它单独在人体中的作用所知甚少。裸盖菇素类迷幻药可能造成恶心、焦虑、混乱、心跳加快与惊恐的经验，并可能在易感者身上诱发精神病。

fact.en: It is psilocybin with one methyl group missing, which is why it is also called norpsilocybin. It occurs as a minor compound in magic mushrooms alongside psilocybin itself.
fact.zh: 它是少了一個甲基的裸蓋菇素，因此也被稱為 norpsilocybin。它以次要成分的形式與裸蓋菇素一同存在於迷幻蘑菇中。
fact.zhHans: 它是少了一个甲基的裸盖菇素，因此也被称为 norpsilocybin。它以次要成分的形式与裸盖菇素一同存在于迷幻蘑菇中。
